result.title: ci: cancel superseded CI Gate runs, normalize the timeout
result.body:
Adds a `concurrency:` group to the `CI Gate` workflow, and normalizes
`timeout-minutes`.

**Concurrency.** Push a new commit to a PR and the running gate job keeps going.
It resolved its target SHA at startup, so it spends the rest of its life polling
for runs on a commit nobody cares about any more, holding a runner the whole
time. `cancel-in-progress` kills it when its replacement starts. The group keys
on `github.ref`, which for a `pull_request` event is `refs/pull/N/merge` — so
it scopes per PR and never cancels across PRs.

Three repos (dirsql, willfire, github-data-file-fetcher) already had this from
an earlier rollout. This brings the other eleven in line.

**Timeout.** Settling the fleet on a single rule: 20 minutes, raised only where
the measured slowest non-gate `pull_request` run gets close. The only repo that
qualifies is putitoutthere at 16 minutes, which stays at 30. dirsql, willfire
and github-data-file-fetcher drop from 45 to 20 — their slowest observed runs
are 7 minutes, under 1 minute, and none-at-all respectively, so 45 just meant a
wedged gate burned twice as long before anyone noticed.

No change to gating behavior.

A gate job resolves its target SHA at startup, so once a new commit
lands on the PR the old run just polls for runs on a commit nobody
cares about, holding a runner until it finishes. The concurrency group
cancels it when the replacement starts. Keyed on github.ref, which for
pull_request is refs/pull/N/merge, so it scopes per PR.

Timeout settles on one fleet rule: 20 minutes, raised only where the
measured slowest non-gate pull_request run gets close. putitoutthere is
the only repo that qualifies (16 min observed, stays at 30).

name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/build.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/build.yml'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - run: uv sync --extra dev
      - name: Build package
        run: uv run just build

name: Changelog

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check CHANGELOG.md and MIGRATIONS.md requirements
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}
        run: |
          SKIP_CHANGELOG=0
          BREAKING=0

          # Dependabot writes its own commits, so it cannot carry a
          # Skip-Changelog trailer and cannot edit CHANGELOG.md. Without an
          # exemption every dependency bump fails here permanently, which in
          # turn reds the CI Gate that aggregates it. Dependency bumps have no
          # consumer-facing behaviour change, which is exactly what the
          # Skip-Changelog trailer is for.
          if [ "$PR_AUTHOR" = "dependabot[bot]" ]; then
            SKIP_CHANGELOG=1
            echo "Author is dependabot[bot]; bypassing CHANGELOG.md requirement."
          fi
          for sha in $(git rev-list "$BASE_SHA".."$HEAD_SHA"); do
            trailers=$(git log -1 --format=%B "$sha" | git interpret-trailers --parse)
            if echo "$trailers" | grep -qiE '^skip-changelog:[[:space:]]*true[[:space:]]*$'; then
              SKIP_CHANGELOG=1
            fi
            if echo "$trailers" | grep -qiE '^breaking-change:[[:space:]]*true[[:space:]]*$'; then
              BREAKING=1
            fi
          done

          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")

          # CHANGELOG.md requirement
          if [ "$SKIP_CHANGELOG" = "1" ]; then
            echo "Skip-Changelog: true trailer found; bypassing CHANGELOG.md requirement."
          elif echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -qx 'CHANGELOG.md'; then
            echo "CHANGELOG.md was updated."
          else
            echo "::error::CHANGELOG.md was not updated in this PR."
            echo ""
            echo "Curtaincall is pre-1.0 and does not strictly follow SemVer, so every PR"
            echo "must add an entry under the [Unreleased] heading in CHANGELOG.md."
            echo ""
            echo "If this PR has no consumer impact (pure CI, internal refactor with no"
            echo "behavior change), add a 'Skip-Changelog: true' trailer to any commit"
            echo "in this PR to bypass the check. Example:"
            echo ""
            echo "    chore: rename internal helper"
            echo ""
            echo "    Skip-Changelog: true"
            exit 1
          fi

          # MIGRATIONS.md requirement, gated on Breaking-Change trailer
          if [ "$BREAKING" = "1" ]; then
            if echo "$CHANGED_FILES" | grep -qx 'MIGRATIONS.md'; then
              echo "Breaking-Change: true trailer found and MIGRATIONS.md was updated."
            else
              echo "::error::A Breaking-Change: true trailer was found but MIGRATIONS.md was not updated."
              echo ""
              echo "Breaking changes and meaningful deprecations require an entry in"
              echo "MIGRATIONS.md under ## Unreleased, with all five required sections:"
              echo "Summary, Required changes, Deprecations removed, Behavior changes"
              echo "without code changes, Verification. See MIGRATIONS.md for the template."
              echo ""
              echo "If this change is not actually breaking, remove the Breaking-Change"
              echo "trailer from the commit(s) in this PR."
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "No Breaking-Change trailer detected; MIGRATIONS.md update not required."
          fi

name: Deploy docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'mkdocs.yml'
      - 'src/curtaincall/**'
      - 'MIGRATIONS.md'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - run: uv sync --extra docs
      - run: uv run mkdocs build
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: site/
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

name: Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'tests/integration/**'
      - '.github/workflows/integration.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - 'tests/integration/**'
      - '.github/workflows/integration.yml'

jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - run: uv sync --extra dev
      - name: Run integration tests
        run: uv run just test-integration

name: Lint

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - run: uv sync --extra dev
      - name: Lint
        run: uv run just lint
      - name: Format check
        run: uv run just format-check

name: PR Monitor

on:
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  # A superseded gate run polls a stale SHA until it finishes. Cancel it.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  # willfire reads the PR and its changed files to predict which workflows dispatch.
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  monitor:
    name: 'CI Gate'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The action has no timeout of its own (see monitor.ts) -- this is the
    # backstop. If a predicted run never dispatches, the gate waits here
    # until the job is killed.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: thekevinscott/pr-monitor@v1

name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Dry-run: compute plan, skip publish + tag'
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - id: plan
        uses: thekevinscott/put-it-out-there@v0
        with:
          command: plan

  build:
    needs: plan
    if: fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix || '[]')[0] != null
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runs_on }}
    # hatch-vcs derives the version from the nearest git tag at build time, but
    # piot does not create the tag until the publish job. Without this handoff
    # the sdist would ship as e.g. 0.5.1.devN. See:
    # https://github.com/thekevinscott/put-it-out-there/blob/main/docs/guide/dynamic-versions.md
    env:
      SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_CURTAINCALL: ${{ matrix.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Python
        if: matrix.kind == 'pypi'
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Build sdist
        if: matrix.kind == 'pypi' && matrix.build != 'maturin' && matrix.target == 'sdist'
        run: |
          cd ${{ matrix.path }}
          python -m pip install build
          python -m build --sdist --outdir dist
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact_name }}
          path: ${{ matrix.artifact_path }}

  publish:
    needs: [plan, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      # PyPI publish shells out to `twine`. Hosted runners don't ship it;
      # install it here so the publish job has twine on PATH.
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install twine
        run: pip install twine
      # piot cuts an annotated tag per publish (`git tag -a`). Hosted
      # runners have no committer identity set; configure one before the
      # piot step or tag creation fails with "Please tell me who you are."
      - name: Configure git identity
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts
      - uses: thekevinscott/put-it-out-there@v0
        with:
          command: publish
          dry_run: ${{ inputs.dry_run || 'false' }}

name: Security

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/security.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - '.github/workflows/security.yml'

jobs:
  bandit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
      - run: uv sync --extra dev
      - name: Run security scan
        run: uv run just security

name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/test.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.py'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'uv.lock'
      - '.github/workflows/test.yml'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.12", "3.13"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - run: uv sync --extra dev
      - name: Run tests
        run: uv run just test-ci
      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          files: coverage.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false
